caption: Custom 2: a slider named Glow setting how much bloom the sparkles have
why: Custom 2 is the fourth slider on the WLED page - a second one of your own, 0..1, with the name you give it.
Use it for a second quality of the effect next to Custom 1: a softness, a trail length, a mix. Its neighbours: Custom 1 and Custom 3; Speed and Intensity.
steps: Custom 2 has no inputs. Its `value` is the slider, 0..1.
**label** is Glow, so that is its name on the WLED page. **default** is 160.
The value is a **Glow**'s amount: sparkles (a **Sparkle** reseeded eight times a second, coloured by the **Palette**) get more halo the further the slider goes.

try.label: Move the slider
try.text: In the side panel's PARAMETERS section, drag the Glow (Custom 2) slider: and the sparkles go from hard dots at the left to soft balls of light at the right. Nothing is rebuilt: the effect reads the slider every frame.

try.label: Rename it
try.text: label Bloom: the slider is called Bloom on the WLED page (and in PARAMETERS) - the effect is rebuilt with the new name.
